data.description:
## Description

**What**: Identify every conditional block in the inlined phase files at skills/onboarding/phases/<phase>.md (stack-specific, CI-platform-specific, design-system-specific, infrastructure-specific, plus any others discovered). Extract each into a topic-scoped prompt file at skills/onboarding/prompts/<topic>.md. Modify each phase file to Read its conditional prompt files only when the phase determines the topic applies. Reduce each phase file to ≤80 non-blank, non-comment lines.

**Why**: The current /dso:onboarding SKILL.md is over 1,800 lines because every conditional path loads on every invocation. SC5 mandates phase-scoped, lazy-loaded conditional content. This is the structural goal of the consolidation.

**Scope**:
- IN: Conditional-axis discovery sub-step (enumerate every conditional block in the inlined phase files; produce an inventory list as a story comment); extraction of each block into prompts/<topic>.md; phase-file modifications to Read prompts conditionally; line-count reduction to ≤80 non-blank, non-comment lines per phase file. Verify Read happens only when needed (lazy in-fact, not just in-name).
- OUT: Behavioral changes to the dialog content itself (this is a structural refactor; content stays parity-preserving). Cross-reference cleanup (S5).

## Done Definitions

- When this story is complete, each phase file at skills/onboarding/phases/<phase>.md is ≤80 non-blank, non-comment lines (counted as: total lines minus lines matching `^\s*$` minus lines matching `^\s*<!--`)
  ← Satisfies: "Phase files in skills/onboarding/phases/<phase>.md are ≤80 non-blank, non-comment lines each."
- When this story is complete, at least one prompts/<topic>.md file exists per conditional axis (stack, CI platform, design system, infrastructure type, plus any others identified during the discovery sub-step)
  ← Satisfies: "Conditional dialogue and behavioral content for each conditional axis ... is decomposed into one or more skills/onboarding/prompts/<topic>.md files."
- When this story is complete, S1's RED tests still pass GREEN (no behavioral regression introduced by decomposition)
  ← Satisfies: parity-preserving refactor invariant.

## Considerations

- [Maintainability] Discovery sub-step (conditional-axis enumeration) is load-bearing — produce an inventory artifact before extraction begins; review against the inlined phase files. Without this, axes are missed and phase files exceed the 80-line cap unevenly.
- [Performance] "Lazy" must mean lazy in execution: phase files Read prompts/<topic>.md only when the phase determines the topic applies, not at every invocation. Verify by reviewing each Read call site.
- [Maintainability] Prompt-file naming convention: skills/onboarding/prompts/<axis>-<topic>.md (e.g., stack-python.md, ci-platform-github-actions.md) for discoverability.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a maintainer, conditional dialog content in /dso:onboarding phases is loaded only when its topic applies
